name: Corn Chips
ingredients_raw: Corn (78%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil), Maltodextrin, Sugar, Dehydrated Vegetables (Onion, Garlic, Tomato), Iodized Salt, Dextrose, Mixed Spices, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein (Corn), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm oil and Sunflower Oil), Anti-caking Agent (INS 551), Acidity Regulator (INS 451(i), INS 330), Emulsifier (INS 1422 & INS 322), Rosemary Extract, Natural & Nature Identical Flavouring Substances.
